prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite atlas for a gentle haunted hand-painted storybook children's panda woods game.
Primary request: ONE transparent sprite atlas, exact clean 3 columns by 2 rows grid. Six fully isolated assets with generous transparent gutters, no labels. Consistent painterly watercolor/gouache textures, warm charming soft outlines, readable game silhouettes, slightly 3/4 view.
Scene/backdrop: actual alpha transparency everywhere outside each asset. No background, no floor, no checkerboard pixels, no shadow plate.
Row 1 column 1: Pip, friendly little anthropomorphic standing owl tutor, round spectacles, cream and chestnut feathers, scarf, carrying tiny glowing lantern. Full body.
Row 1 column 2: Bramble, cute anthropomorphic standing hedgehog gatekeeper in moss coat waistcoat, holding clipboard. Full body.
Row 1 column 3: Moss, kind anthropomorphic standing russet fox explorer with green cape and pouch. Full body.
Row 2 column 1: ornate CLOSED wooden woodland door within standalone timber arch, curved top and brass lock, ivy. Stable complete door and arch contained.
Row 2 column 2: small brass skeleton key, crescent shaped handle, big readable silhouette.
Row 2 column 3: isolated landmark group of EXACTLY THREE PALE BIRCH trunks framing vivid BLUE mushrooms at their roots, no ground slab.
Composition: each asset sits wholly inside its own equal grid cell; large clear transparent space between adjacent assets. No cropping, no overlap between cells. Characters same scale. Canvas landscape 3:2, make six assets generously sized.
Constraints: no text, no extra assets, no backdrop, no environmental floor, no borders or grid lines, genuine transparent background.
